name: Julius
source:
The Magician of July / The Time Magician

The patient and soft-spoken Magician who rules over time. He's the most incomplete Magician, as the universe's creator (Clavie) was unable to perfect time magic. The July world of time exists nowhere and everywhere at the same time. Thus, Julius' home world is a small pocket dimension which can be summoned from any other world.

He's the only Magician who has aged past a young adult phase due to his unstable nature as the Time Magician. Apparently he used to be much harsher and unforgiving like time itself, but the years have mellowed him out. Now, he's more like a sophisticated and gentle uncle who watches over time and those who dare to fight against it.

Many of his fellow Magicians respect him and look to him as a father figure. This especially goes for Octavia, who is trapped underground and has no contact with anyone besides Julius.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12670392.julius]official bio[/url]]
